changelog: Completely new app look: a native Material Design interface (light theme, top app bar, bottom navigation, floating Add button, mini player) that shares nothing with this website
New adaptive launcher icon and launch screen — installs and behaves like any regular Android app
Android back button: closes the player, menus and sheets, returns to the Library, then sends the app to the background instead of quitting
Music keeps playing with the screen off or while you use other apps
Dark / System theme option; status and navigation bars follow the app theme
Library filters (All / Favorites), sort by recently added, title or artist; ⋮ menus and in-app dialogs replace browser pop-ups
Auto Purify engine unchanged: every song is analyzed on import and its music is removed automatically on playback
